text:
elaine: VoltFlux asked for a focused perf/W + throughput bench next week for marketplace onboarding + joint notes. Need kernel tuning, perf counters, and an embargoed figure pack.

sam: Which model and seq lengths? VPN + perfmon access?

alex-voltflux: We can enable VPN and perfmon on rigs 1-3 by Tue EOD. Use model: rw-mini (512/2048).

diego: Test matrix: modes=fp16,int8,q4_0; kernels=stock,fused-attn,cublas-tuned; powercap on/off. Collect steady-state perf/W and p95/p99 throughput. KV-cache thrash test included.

kira: Telemetry fields minimal: run_id, ts, host_pdu_w, gpu_power_w, p50/p95/p99_ms, ipc, l2_miss. We'll provide CSV + dashboard. Raw traces require NDA addendum.

elaine: Owners: Sam=bench ops, Diego=kernel tuning, Kira=telemetry, Elaine=PM/announce. Agree?

sam: Agreed. I'll do a dry-run Wed, tune Thu, full sweep Fri if VPN is up. Need Alex to allow perfmon & kernel debug.

bench-bot: Run queued id=bench-1729999999 start=1729993600 modes=fp16,int8,q4_0.

diego: Pin driver stack in logs: nvidia-535 / cuda-12.1 / cublas-12.1. If mismatch, we'll record compatibility notes.

elaine: Action items: 1) Alex enable VPN+perfmon Tue EOD. 2) Sam prep runner + dashboard. 3) Diego supply tuning knobs + safe defaults. 4) Kira create telemetry bucket and share perms. 5) PM open legal for raw dumps.

sam: Runner snippet:
```bash
run-bench --model rw-mini --seq 2048 --modes fp16,int8,q4_0 \
  --dur 3600 --telemetry s3://redwood-partner-voltflux/bench-1729999999 \
  --rigs 1,2,3
```

alex-voltflux: I'll confirm VPN + perfmon and perms by Tue noon. We want the embargoed figure pack by next Mon.

elaine: Thanks — I'll draft the co-announcement playbook and loop legal/marketing.
